turns.client: I think one realistic way to cope with distractions could be to set a timer for short bursts of focused work, maybe like 25 minutes, and then take a quick break. That way, I can give myself permission to step away and recharge without feeling like I’m abandoning the work. I could also create a little reminder on my desk about why I’m doing this, like a quote or a photo related to my research. It might help ground me when I'm feeling overwhelmed. I'm still a bit apprehensive about whether I'll actually follow through, but I like the idea of having those tools in place to help me if I struggle.
